detailed_descriptions_html.en:
from beneath the city, we leave our mark with every step, we rise

Two series that have shaped rhythm game history—EZ2 series and PUMP IT UP series, Come together!

Now, EZ2ON and PUMP IT UP meet on PC, bringing their music together on one stage.

From the joy of revisiting familiar melodies to the thrill of new challenges,

enjoy a special experience brought to life by this collaboration.

─

'PUMP IT UP RISE Collaboration DLC' is a special collaboration DLC with "PUMP IT UP RISE".

Centered on PUMP IT UP RISE, a collection of 20 tracks spanning the series' past and present arrives in EZ2ON REBOOT : R.

Beloved classics and new musical discoveries alike.

From beloved classics to fresh discoveries, experience them all in a way only EZ2ON can offer!
